parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description:
操作类型，取值：

- `UnBindEip`：解绑EIP。

- `BindEip`：绑定一个EIP。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh modify-api-server-eip-resource --service-mesh-id cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --operation BindEip --api-server-eip-id eip-bp1adu9jegmxnaoq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh ModifyApiServerEipResource --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --ApiServerEipId 'eip-bp1adu9jegmxnaoq0000' --Operation BindEip
